name: Espresso
description: Keep your Mac and its screen awake, indefinitely or for a set time.
author: Giuseppe
details: Keep your Mac and its screen awake, like a coffee for your computer. Indefinitely, for 10 minutes up to 12 hours, or until a time you pick. It only holds power assertions, which macOS releases by itself when Notcholino stops.
features: Awake for as long as you choose
Nothing is left behind when it stops
Same effect as the caffeinate command
